Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000253": The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000242": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000235": Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle as of 2025-02-27, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000230": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team pinged the owners of the ledger service about the memory growth.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000216" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000204": Tomasz is off the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-02-12.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000201": Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000183": The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000177" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000155": The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000118": The indexer is owned by Cinder.  (about: Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000112": Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000109" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000075": Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
Existing entity names: ledger service, auth gateway, Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team, Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego, authentication gateway, Atlas team, Tomasz, Priya Raman, billing API, feature-flags, job scheduler, notifier, INC-2025-004, Postgres 14, product catalog, indexer
